description: Defines the TransactionsState class managing financial transactions, including filtering by month, adding income/expenses, and calculating totals, with sample seed data.

classes.name: TransactionsState
classes.description: Manages a list of transactions, filtering by month, adding income/expenses, and calculating totals with sample seed data.

methods.name: setMonth
methods.description: Sets the current selected month for filtering transactions.

methods.name: addIncome
methods.description: Adds an income transaction to the list.

methods.name: addExpense
methods.description: Adds an expense transaction to the list.

methods.name: monthTransactions
methods.description: Returns transactions filtered by the selected month, sorted descending by date.

methods.name: incomeTotal
methods.description: Calculates total income for the selected month.

methods.name: expenseTotal
methods.description: Calculates total expenses for the selected month.

methods.name: netBalance
methods.description: Calculates net balance (income minus expenses) for the selected month.
